## About

Darshita Singh is a Full-Stack Developer, Software Engineer, and UI Designer.
She builds end-to-end web applications using React, Node.js, Express.js, Django REST Framework, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL.
She has worked with AI-powered CRM workflows, generative AI integrations via the Anthropic Claude API, and intelligent automation systems.
Her technical positioning: UI/UX-focused Full-Stack Developer combining frontend engineering with product-oriented thinking.

## Projects

- **Vrinda Valley Resort** — Full-stack luxury resort booking platform (React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, Express 5, MongoDB Atlas, Cloudinary). Content payload optimised from ~5 MB to 11 KB. Live: https://www.vrindavalleyresort.com/
- **DevJobsBoard** — Full-stack job aggregation platform with AI-assisted ATS resume scoring. All resume parsing is client-side. Live: https://devjobsboard-web.onrender.com/
- **Manova Mental Wellness** — Responsive wellness site for a CBT practitioner with bilingual English/Hindi chatbot, animated booking flow, and browser-based wellness tools.
